# Technology Operations

### Safe, coordinated, scalable solutions for unmanned and autonomous operations environments

### We are a technology company built on years of complex airspace management and UAS operations
### experience.

### This foundation uniquely positions us to deliver autonomous airspace management solutions that
### serve both regulators and operators.

[ Let's Talk ][17]

## From integrated awareness to coordinated resilience outcomes through orchestration

Today's national airspace operates under static regulations, opaque approvals and fragmented
systems; an unsustainable framework that moves at paper-speed and threatens airspace sovereignty and
security.

Legacy systems are siloed, lack real-time coordination, and can't scale with growing automated
aircraft. Airspace authorities also lack unified digital visibility across manned, unmanned and UAS
threats.

We provide an open modular system that enables a safe, coordinated airspace.

## **Scaling UAS Operations Through Regulatory-Tech Synergy**

We turn complex FAA compliance into a simple partnership. Through our agency model, your team can
operate advanced UAS operations at scale without navigating the time-consuming regulatory process
yourself.  

We handle compliance, oversight, and technology requirements - you focus on your business operations
and operate with Uncrew.

It's UAS advancement made accessible.

[ Learn more ][19]
 

## Our Core Technology

## **ATOMx**

The universal layer that aligns authorizations, sensing, and policy coordination across operational
domains.
* **Scale Beyond Paper:**  Cryptographic identity and intent assurance that establishes who, what,
  and why for each mission
* **Dynamic Airspace Rules:**  Policy-driven rule propagation and coordination that supports
  real-time compliance across systems
* **Threat Mitigation:**  Integrated threat-awareness and response coordination layer that aligns
  detection, assessment, and mitigation systems

## Uncrew

An open autonomy platform that seamlessly works with any drone, replaces manual piloting, and brings
safe, compliant, and scalable UAS operations to the skies.
* **Single Pane of Glass:**  A centralized view provides a centralized view of all drone flights
  with routing optimized for safe, deconflicted airspace
* **An operating system for any drone:**  works with any drone, providing adaptive control for
  delivery and inspection missions
* **Team Workspace:**  share data, supervise missions across teams and partners

[ Book a Demo ][20]

#### To revolutionize airspace management and situational awareness while advancing UAS autonomy

#### a safe, coordinated, autonomous airspace that will define Advanced Air Mobility's future.

## What We Believe

### Safe, coordinated, autonomous airspace requires three key pillars:

#### Awareness: Complete situational understanding

#### Control: Coordinated orchestration and automation

#### Assurance: Resilient, continuous performance

* ## Regulatory + Operations Enablement:
  
  **We streamline complex regulations to enable operators for advanced operations.**
* ## Open Platform, Unlimited Scale:
  
  **Open, interoperable architecture that is purpose-built for large-scale deployment.**
* ## Future-Ready:
  
  **Supporting today's operations while preparing for tomorrow's regulations.**
* ## Proven Experience:
  
  **Real-world operational background, not just theoretical solutions.**
* ## Seasoned Team:
  
  **Veterans from military, LEO, special operations & airspace policy.**

## The Outcome:

### **When regulatory and operator tools work together, they create one coordinated, safe, scalable,
### autonomous airspace ecosystem.**

Textron Systems continues to advance ground robotic capabilities that enhance expeditionary
maneuver, mission flexibility and warfighter survivability. The M1 robotic vehicle represents the
latest expansion of our compact robotic platforms where mobility, adaptability and rapid deployment

intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) and signals intelligence (SIGINT).

Southcom And U.S. Navy Fourth Fleet

April 30, 2026

HUNT VALLEY, Md., April 30, 2026 – Textron Systems Corporation, a Textron Inc. (NYSE:TXT) company,
announced today a contract award from the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) to produce and deliver
multiple TSUNAMI ® Uncrewed Surface Vessels (USVs), which will be used to support the U.S. Navy
Fleet Experimentation (FLEX) exercise in Key West, Florida and provide three months of joint
operations with SOUTHCOM and the U.S. Navy Fourth Fleet. Under the contract, Textron Systems will
provide the long dwell TSUNAMI interceptor USVs and Field Service Representatives (FSRs) to the FLEX
exercise, demonstrating cooperative intelligence, surveillance reconnaissance and targeting (ISR-T)
with its Aerosonde ® 4.7 VTOL UAS off a Littoral Combat Ship (LCS). The exercise will also
demonstrate manned-unmanned surface warfare with Invariant Corporation’s Surface-to-Air Kinetic
Engagement (STAKE) system. The TSUNAMI family of autonomous maritime surface vessels are designed to
meet the needs of the U.S.

## Stock and shipping information

We strive to keep you informed about the availability and shipping timelines for each product.
Here’s how it works:
* **In Stock:**
  This item is currently in stock and ready for dispatch. Stock may be located in one of our EU
  warehouses. All orders ship from a central EU location, so if the item is stored in a different EU
  warehouse, we will first transfer it to our central warehouse before shipping it directly to you.
  This may add a small delay, but our team prioritizes quick processing to minimize any wait time.
* **Available on Order:**
  This item is not currently in stock, but we can order it for you. Once we place the order, it
  typically takes up to 3 weeks for the item to arrive at our central EU warehouse. From there, it
  will be shipped to you. Please note this extended timeline when planning your purchase.
* **Out of Stock:**
  This item is currently unavailable for purchase. If you’re interested in obtaining this product,
  you can apply to join the **Waitlist** on the product page. By joining the Waitlist, you’ll
  receive an email notification as soon as the product is back in stock. Alternatively, feel free to
  contact us directly if you’d like more information about future availability.

If you have any questions or would like more detailed information about the availability or

## Stock and shipping information

We strive to keep you informed about the availability and shipping timelines for each product.
Here’s how it works:
* **In Stock:**
  This item is currently in stock and ready for dispatch. Stock may be located in one of our EU
  warehouses. All orders ship from a central EU location, so if the item is stored in a different EU
  warehouse, we will first transfer it to our central warehouse before shipping it directly to you.
  This may add a small delay, but our team prioritizes quick processing to minimize any wait time.
* **Available on Order:**
  This item is not currently in stock, but we can order it for you. Once we place the order, it
  typically takes up to 3 weeks for the item to arrive at our central EU warehouse. From there, it
  will be shipped to you. Please note this extended timeline when planning your purchase.
* **Out of Stock:**
  This item is currently unavailable for purchase. If you’re interested in obtaining this product,
  you can apply to join the **Waitlist** on the product page. By joining the Waitlist, you’ll
  receive an email notification as soon as the product is back in stock. Alternatively, feel free to
  contact us directly if you’d like more information about future availability.

If you have any questions or would like more detailed information about the availability or
estimated arrival date for a specific item, please don’t hesitate to reach out to our support team.

# Powered by farmers for farmers

# About
# AGX

At AGX Drone Distributors, we’re committed to bringing the best agricultural drone technology to
farmers across Australia.

We partner with world-leading brands including EAVision, XAG, and DJI to deliver reliable,
high-performance drones built for Australian conditions. From broadacre to horticulture and
forestry, our drones are helping growers and contractors lift efficiency, accuracy, and
profitability.

Beyond sales, AGX also operates one of Australia’s largest agricultural drone contracting fleets,
providing professional spraying, spreading, and mapping services nationwide. With thousands of
hectares completed each season, our team has hands-on experience that ensures we know exactly what
works in the field.

Backed by real-world knowledge, a strong safety culture, and nationwide support, AGX is more than a
distributor — we’re an operational partner helping drive the future of smart farming across
Australia

# Powered by farmers for farmers

[A vast yellow field of flowering plants under a partly cloudy sky with patches of blue.]

# About
# AGX

At AGX Drone Distributors, we’re committed to bringing the best agricultural drone technology to
farmers across Australia.

We partner with world-leading brands including EAVision, XAG, and DJI to deliver reliable,
high-performance drones built for Australian conditions. From broadacre to horticulture and
forestry, our drones are helping growers and contractors lift efficiency, accuracy, and
profitability.

Beyond sales, AGX also operates one of Australia’s largest agricultural drone contracting fleets,
providing professional spraying, spreading, and mapping services nationwide. With thousands of
hectares completed each season, our team has hands-on experience that ensures we know exactly what
works in the field.

Backed by real-world knowledge, a strong safety culture, and nationwide support, AGX is more than a
distributor — we’re an operational partner helping drive the future of smart farming across
Australia

[Close-up of a weathered concrete post with a rusted chain hanging from it, outdoors in a field with
green grass and trees in the background, during sunset.]

# INNOVATIVE UAS TECHNOLOGY

[Learn More][22]

### [INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGY STACK][23]

Accelerating Defence Innovation, Redefined at ALTUS-LSA, we don’t follow—we lead. As a disruptive
force in defence technology, we identify tomorrow’s challenges today, self-fund the R&D to solve
them, and bring fully developed, deployable systems straight to market. Our rapid innovation cycle
turns ideas into operational solutions in months, not years—delivering unmatched value.

### [EMPOWERING A SAFER & SMARTER WORLD VIA DUAL USE UAS!][24]

At the intersection of defence precision and civilian innovation lies the true power of dual-use UAS
technology. These platforms are not just flying machines—they’re force multipliers. From protecting
borders and saving lives in crisis zones, to monitoring forests and inspecting infrastructure, they
prove that the same cutting-edge capability can serve both security and society.

### [UAS END USER CENTRICITY][25]

Our platforms are built with modular, customizable features—empowering users to adapt, expand, and
integrate with purpose. From specialized payloads to emerging technologies, every function supports
a greater mission. At ALTUS-LSA, we don’t just serve clients—we stand by partners. With a
customer-first mindset, we deliver rapid-response support and immediate spare parts availability
throughout Greece and Europe.

## We are about Quality and Trust

### [Unmanned Systems][26]

Our strength lies in its deep domain knowledge and operational experience across Defence, Security,
and Industrial Sectors.

### [Operational team][27]

Operational Excellence, Powered by High Caliber Personnel. Behind every successful mission is a team
that’s flown it before.

### [Quality & Certifications][28]

Excellence is not just a benchmark, It fuels our dedication to designing, developing, and delivering
Unmanned Aircraft Systems that embody the highest standards.

## Featured Products

### [ATLAS 8 Electric][29]

The ATLAS 8 family is a heavy lifter multi-copter addressing the emerging requirements of the small
cargo (goods, weapons, search and rescue means, etc) and last mile (commercial products) transport
market.

### [ATLAS 204 – A20][30]

ATLAS 204 A20 Drone System is designed to deliver high reliability & mission oriented multi-rotor
capabilities in the fields of defence, security & industrial surveillance.

### [ATLAS 4][31]

ATLAS 4 Drone System is designed to deliver “out of the normal” multi-rotor capabilities in the
fields of surveillance, industrial monitoring and small cargo delivery applications.

### [DRONE HANGAR][32]

The Drone Hangar solution operates with our multi-rotor drones like an expert pilot and enables
autonomous remote operations at hazardous environments.

### [EDOMON][33]

EDOMON is a Hybrid VTOL UAV based on Supervolo Aerial Platform, designed to deliver reliable and
efficient ISR Operations for the Law enforcement, Civil Protection and Defence Market.

### [M3NTOR][34]

M3NTOR is an innovative network centric, hierarchical , C3 assets and mission management system with
the capability to control and navigate multiple drones in a 3D projected environment.

# Kaspersky Antidrone – an agile system for detecting and counteracting drones

The Kaspersky Antidrone detection and counteraction system lets you detect, classify, and even
mitigate various types and classes of civilian UAVs, if such action is necessary and has been
authorized. The configuration of each system is unique and depends on the specific threat model.

The cost of the product depends on the specific requirements and technical capabilities of the
customer. To calculate the exact cost of the product and purchase it, please contact an official
partner of Kaspersky in your region.

[Contact us][15]
Software from a world leader in cybersecurity
Kaspersky is an international company that has been engaged in information security since 1997. Our
in-depth expertise and years of experience are at the heart of all our next-generation security
solutions and services that safeguard businesses, critical infrastructure, and industry.
Neural networks and artificial intelligence
Kaspersky Antidrone uses unique software that is unrivaled on the market. Algorithms powered by AI
and neural networks ensure the fastest processing of data received from various types of hardware
sensors and provide comprehensive UAV analytics in a single interface that can be understood by
operators without technical skills.
High-grade hardware
Only a suite of hardware sensors running on software algorithms, rather than a collection of
separate technologies, can provide the required level of antidrone protection in the modern world.
We use our proprietary hardware modules and the best available third-party hardware sensors, which
have passed internal testing.
Ecosystemic and scalable approach
At the architectural level, the solution is intended to be modular, scalable and form part of an
ecosystem. This allows our customers not only to purchase a final product, but also to invest in a
comprehensive, future-proof security system. Kaspersky Antidrone integrates with industrial security
systems, interfaces with outdoor security cameras, and provides reliable UAV monitoring.
KASPERSKY ANTIDRONE

## Customers

State-of-the-art unmanned aerial vehicles are capable not only of reconnaissance, but also of posing
genuine risks to your infrastructure, business, and the safety and security of people. The Kaspersky
Antidrone system identifies threats in the earliest stages to provide timely warnings and effective
countermeasures.

### Protection of energy sector from drones

Integration of counter-unmanned aircraft system into the existing security infrastructure of energy
sector facilities.

### Protection of DPCs from drones

Prevention of unauthorized drone access to critical IT infrastructure at data processing centers.

### Protection of substations from drones

Airspace monitoring above electrical substations and protection from UAVs to prevent damage or
unauthorized observation.

### Protection of fuel storage tanks from drones

Control and protection of storage areas containing fuel and other hazardous substances from
potential drone threats.

### Protection of enterprises from drones

Complex approach to the detection, identification and suppression of UAVs over manufacturing
facilities.

### Regional counter-UAV system

The Kaspersky Antidrone software platform can combine anti-drone systems from different
manufacturers into one unified system and monitor UAVs from a single operations center. The software
facilitates machine learning and neural network technologies. It ensures high-speed data processing
from a variety of hardware sensors and provides comprehensive UAV analytics in a unified interface.

# Kaspersky Antidrone – an agile system for detecting and counteracting drones

The Kaspersky Antidrone detection and counteraction system lets you detect, classify, and even
mitigate various types and classes of civilian UAVs, if such action is necessary and has been
authorized. The configuration of each system is unique and depends on the specific threat model.

The cost of the product depends on the specific requirements and technical capabilities of the
customer. To calculate the exact cost of the product and purchase it, please contact an official
partner of Kaspersky in your region.

[Contact us][15]
Software from a world leader in cybersecurity
Kaspersky is an international company that has been engaged in information security since 1997. Our
in-depth expertise and years of experience are at the heart of all our next-generation security
solutions and services that safeguard businesses, critical infrastructure, and industry.
Neural networks and artificial intelligence
Kaspersky Antidrone uses unique software that is unrivaled on the market. Algorithms powered by AI
and neural networks ensure the fastest processing of data received from various types of hardware
sensors and provide comprehensive UAV analytics in a single interface that can be understood by
operators without technical skills.
High-grade hardware
Only a suite of hardware sensors running on software algorithms, rather than a collection of
separate technologies, can provide the required level of antidrone protection in the modern world.
We use our proprietary hardware modules and the best available third-party hardware sensors, which
have passed internal testing.
Ecosystemic and scalable approach
At the architectural level, the solution is intended to be modular, scalable and form part of an
ecosystem. This allows our customers not only to purchase a final product, but also to invest in a
comprehensive, future-proof security system. Kaspersky Antidrone integrates with industrial security
systems, interfaces with outdoor security cameras, and provides reliable UAV monitoring.
KASPERSKY ANTIDRONE

## Customers

State-of-the-art unmanned aerial vehicles are capable not only of reconnaissance, but also of posing
genuine risks to your infrastructure, business, and the safety and security of people. The Kaspersky
Antidrone system identifies threats in the earliest stages to provide timely warnings and effective
countermeasures.

### Protection of energy sector from drones

Integration of counter-unmanned aircraft system into the existing security infrastructure of energy
sector facilities.

### Protection of DPCs from drones

Prevention of unauthorized drone access to critical IT infrastructure at data processing centers.

### Protection of substations from drones

Airspace monitoring above electrical substations and protection from UAVs to prevent damage or
unauthorized observation.

### Protection of fuel storage tanks from drones

Control and protection of storage areas containing fuel and other hazardous substances from
potential drone threats.

### Protection of enterprises from drones

Complex approach to the detection, identification and suppression of UAVs over manufacturing
facilities.

### Regional counter-UAV system

The Kaspersky Antidrone software platform can combine anti-drone systems from different
manufacturers into one unified system and monitor UAVs from a single operations center. The software
facilitates machine learning and neural network technologies. It ensures high-speed data processing
from a variety of hardware sensors and provides comprehensive UAV analytics in a unified interface.

espionage and breach of confidentiality during the production process.

[frequently asked questions][42]
* What retail services does Channel Partners provide?
  
  We run the full field execution ecosystem: merchandising and resets, break fix and continuity,
  audits and compliance, assisted sales and training, construction, warehousing and fulfillment, and
  experiential marketing. Every program runs through Retail Intelligence™, our framework for turning
  field visits into real-time, actionable data instead of after-the-fact activity reports.
* Does Channel Partners use W-2 employees or gig workers?
  
  W-2 employees, exclusively. More than 7,500 field representatives across our network are trained
  in person and certified before deployment. We do not use gig or 1099 labor, because compliance
  outcomes depend on people with a stake in the work, not a shift to complete.
* How does Channel Partners report on store visits in real time?
  
  Every program runs through OpenSky™, our proprietary field intelligence platform. It provides
  GPS-verified visit confirmation, AI-validated photo documentation, and exception alerts the moment
  an issue is identified, not in an end-of-week summary. Dashboards are configured around your
  specific program and KPIs.
* What is H.U.M.A.N. and how is it different from a standard audit?
  
  H.U.M.A.N. (Human-Unified Merchandising & Audit Navigator) pairs trained reps with smart glasses
  and a body camera to capture a full shift, not a snapshot. OpenSky™ analyzes the footage against
  your brand standards in real time and surfaces corrections to the rep as they walk the store.
* Does Channel Partners only work with large national retail chains?
  
  No. We run programs from single-location resets to full-chain rollouts across 2,000+ stores, and
  from local market activations to national campaigns. Our clients span consumer electronics,
  mobile, beauty, grocery, and big-box retail. Program scale is built around your footprint.
* Can Channel Partners run merchandising, construction, and logistics under one program?
  
  Yes. That is the premise of Retail Intelligence™: one partner running merchandising, construction,
  logistics, audits, and field sales as a connected system instead of separate vendors. Each program
  feeds the same intelligence platform, so you get one data view across everything we run for you.
* Does Channel Partners have its own warehouses?
  
  Yes. We operate six asset-backed facilities across five states, Baltimore, Columbus (two
  locations, including Granville), Dallas, Irvine, and Reno, totaling 500,000 square feet and
  putting us within two-day transit of 87% of U.S. shoppers. Receiving, kitting, transportation, and
  end-of-life recovery run as one connected supply chain built around your installation schedule,
  not general fulfillment.
* Where does Channel Partners operate?
  
  Nationwide, with regional depth where it counts. General trade crews travel coast to coast for
  construction projects. MEP trades are always sourced in-market for local code and permitting
  knowledge, with go-to teams in the West Coast, Midwest, Southeast, and Texas.
* Does Channel Partners handle construction permitting and inspections?
  
  Yes, for projects involving electrical, plumbing, or wall moves, which typically require permits.
  These projects move through drawings from your architect or engineer; if you haven’t engaged one,
  we can contract one on your behalf. MEP trades are always sourced in-market for code and inspector
  familiarity.
* What kind of reporting do I get on a break fix or continuity program?
  
  Real-time issue status, resolution verification, and photo documentation across your full display
  network through OpenSky™. Roughly half of display issues identified in the field are resolved
  on-site during the same visit, with before-and-after functionality documented in every report.
* Is Channel Partners an approved partner for major retailers like Best Buy and Target?
  
  Yes. We’re recognized as a Best Buy Approved 3PL Provider and a Target Preferred Merchandising
  Partner, designations earned through performance rather than bid pricing. We’ve also run audit
  programs for Best Buy, including a Customer Experience Audit engagement that grew into an ongoing
  six-month program.
* Is Channel Partners the same company as Apollo, BDS, or MAG?
  
  Yes. Apollo, BDS, WhiteHawk, BTR, MAG, and MAAS have been unified into Channel Partners. Same
  teams, same client relationships, one brand, one platform. If you worked with any of these names
  before, you’re working with Channel Partners now.
* Can Channel Partners show whether a program is actually driving sales, not just confirming visits
  happened?
  
  Yes, through Strategy & Analytics, a dedicated engagement layered on top of standard reporting. A
  Channel Partners analyst connects your field data to outside datasets to answer sales lift, brand
  awareness, and competitive intelligence questions, not just whether the visit happened.

[frequently asked questions][42]
* What retail services does Channel Partners provide?
  
  We run the full field execution ecosystem: merchandising and resets, break fix and continuity,
  audits and compliance, assisted sales and training, construction, warehousing and fulfillment, and
  experiential marketing. Every program runs through Retail Intelligence™, our framework for turning
  field visits into real-time, actionable data instead of after-the-fact activity reports.
* Does Channel Partners use W-2 employees or gig workers?
  
  W-2 employees, exclusively. More than 7,500 field representatives across our network are trained
  in person and certified before deployment. We do not use gig or 1099 labor, because compliance
  outcomes depend on people with a stake in the work, not a shift to complete.
* How does Channel Partners report on store visits in real time?
  
  Every program runs through OpenSky™, our proprietary field intelligence platform. It provides
  GPS-verified visit confirmation, AI-validated photo documentation, and exception alerts the moment
  an issue is identified, not in an end-of-week summary. Dashboards are configured around your
  specific program and KPIs.
* What is H.U.M.A.N. and how is it different from a standard audit?
  
  H.U.M.A.N. (Human-Unified Merchandising & Audit Navigator) pairs trained reps with smart glasses
  and a body camera to capture a full shift, not a snapshot. OpenSky™ analyzes the footage against
  your brand standards in real time and surfaces corrections to the rep as they walk the store.
* Does Channel Partners only work with large national retail chains?
  
  No. We run programs from single-location resets to full-chain rollouts across 2,000+ stores, and
  from local market activations to national campaigns. Our clients span consumer electronics,
  mobile, beauty, grocery, and big-box retail. Program scale is built around your footprint.
* Can Channel Partners run merchandising, construction, and logistics under one program?
  
  Yes. That is the premise of Retail Intelligence™: one partner running merchandising, construction,
  logistics, audits, and field sales as a connected system instead of separate vendors. Each program
  feeds the same intelligence platform, so you get one data view across everything we run for you.
* Does Channel Partners have its own warehouses?
  
  Yes. We operate six asset-backed facilities across five states, Baltimore, Columbus (two
  locations, including Granville), Dallas, Irvine, and Reno, totaling 500,000 square feet and
  putting us within two-day transit of 87% of U.S. shoppers. Receiving, kitting, transportation, and
  end-of-life recovery run as one connected supply chain built around your installation schedule,
  not general fulfillment.
* Where does Channel Partners operate?
  
  Nationwide, with regional depth where it counts. General trade crews travel coast to coast for
  construction projects. MEP trades are always sourced in-market for local code and permitting
  knowledge, with go-to teams in the West Coast, Midwest, Southeast, and Texas.
* Does Channel Partners handle construction permitting and inspections?
  
  Yes, for projects involving electrical, plumbing, or wall moves, which typically require permits.
  These projects move through drawings from your architect or engineer; if you haven’t engaged one,
  we can contract one on your behalf. MEP trades are always sourced in-market for code and inspector
  familiarity.
* What kind of reporting do I get on a break fix or continuity program?
  
  Real-time issue status, resolution verification, and photo documentation across your full display
  network through OpenSky™. Roughly half of display issues identified in the field are resolved
  on-site during the same visit, with before-and-after functionality documented in every report.
* Is Channel Partners an approved partner for major retailers like Best Buy and Target?
  
  Yes. We’re recognized as a Best Buy Approved 3PL Provider and a Target Preferred Merchandising
  Partner, designations earned through performance rather than bid pricing. We’ve also run audit
  programs for Best Buy, including a Customer Experience Audit engagement that grew into an ongoing
  six-month program.
* Is Channel Partners the same company as Apollo, BDS, or MAG?
  
  Yes. Apollo, BDS, WhiteHawk, BTR, MAG, and MAAS have been unified into Channel Partners. Same
  teams, same client relationships, one brand, one platform. If you worked with any of these names
  before, you’re working with Channel Partners now.
* Can Channel Partners show whether a program is actually driving sales, not just confirming visits
  happened?
  
  Yes, through Strategy & Analytics, a dedicated engagement layered on top of standard reporting. A
  Channel Partners analyst connects your field data to outside datasets to answer sales lift, brand
  awareness, and competitive intelligence questions, not just whether the visit happened.

## Better Growth, Better Life

DJI Agriculture not only empowers agriculture professionals with powerful equipment but also
provides intelligent solutions that save time and increase workflow, benefiting a wide range of
customers from farmers and growers to agricultural cooperation and service agencies.

## DJI Agras T50 and T25 Expand Aerial Crop Protection Capabilities

## Over 300,000 drones operate globally, treating more than 500 million hectares of farmland around
## the world.

## What you need to know about insurance for your agriculture drones

[Nutrition drone]

## Revolutionizing Agave Farming: Using Agras T50 Drones to Spray Agave

### Solutions

DJI Agriculture not only empowers agriculture professionals with powerful equipment but also
provides intelligent solutions that save time and increase workflow, benefiting a wide range of
customers from farmers and growers to agricultural cooperation and service agencies.

[Grain Crops]

### Grain Crops

Our solutions provide digital, informative, intelligent, and precise field management for grain
crops such as rice, wheat, and corn. This empowers agricultural operators with more convenient and
efficient options, reduces operation costs, improves crop quality, and increases yield rate.

[Commercial Crops]

### Commercial Crops

We also provide digital, informative, intelligent, and precise management solutions for commercial
crops such as cotton, citrus trees, apple trees, and tea plants. As with grain crops, agoperators
will find these options more convenient, inexpensive, and beneficial to crop quality and yield rate.

### Explore

### User Stories

Witness ordinary people exceeding their harvest goals thanks to our Agricultural solutions.

### News

DJI’s agricultural project has generated over 30,000 new jobs and is committed to strengthening the

## Better Growth, Better Life

DJI Agriculture not only empowers agriculture professionals with powerful equipment but also
provides intelligent solutions that save time and increase workflow, benefiting a wide range of
customers from farmers and growers to agricultural cooperation and service agencies.

## DJI Agras T50 and T25 Expand Aerial Crop Protection Capabilities

## Over 300,000 drones operate globally, treating more than 500 million hectares of farmland around
## the world.

## What you need to know about insurance for your agriculture drones

[Nutrition drone]

## Revolutionizing Agave Farming: Using Agras T50 Drones to Spray Agave

### Solutions

DJI Agriculture not only empowers agriculture professionals with powerful equipment but also
provides intelligent solutions that save time and increase workflow, benefiting a wide range of
customers from farmers and growers to agricultural cooperation and service agencies.

[Grain Crops]

### Grain Crops

Our solutions provide digital, informative, intelligent, and precise field management for grain
crops such as rice, wheat, and corn. This empowers agricultural operators with more convenient and
efficient options, reduces operation costs, improves crop quality, and increases yield rate.

[Commercial Crops]

### Commercial Crops

We also provide digital, informative, intelligent, and precise management solutions for commercial
crops such as cotton, citrus trees, apple trees, and tea plants. As with grain crops, agoperators
will find these options more convenient, inexpensive, and beneficial to crop quality and yield rate.

### Explore

### User Stories

Witness ordinary people exceeding their harvest goals thanks to our Agricultural solutions.

### User Cases

Are you interested in ridding your fields of insects like Panonychus citri (McGregor) with DJI
Agriculture Drones? Find out more.

### News

DJI’s agricultural project has generated over 30,000 new jobs and is committed to strengthening the
agriculture industry and benefiting farmers everywhere.

AI/ML-enabled Anti-Drone Solution

Dedrone is revolutionizing drone defense with our advanced AI-Driven Autonomous C2 platform.

We have gone beyond the limits of simple sensor correlation to incorporate advanced algorithms and
proprietary machine learning techniques, such as behavior model filters, neural networks and
AI-based imagery through over 18 million images. By leveraging these sophisticated methods, Dedrone
has virtually eliminated false positives in our drone detection system, providing unmatched accuracy
and reliability. Our cutting-edge platform and continuous commitment to innovation is changing the
game for lower airspace security.

## Drone Data Collection.

#### Saving money

We collect your data and manage it intelligently with the help of **AI** and our drones we save you
a lot of time. You know, time is money.

#### Scalable network

With Italy’s largest and most well-trained network of **professional drone pilots**, we can meet
your needs, anywhere, anytime.

#### Work smart

We use algorithms based on **machine learning** to minimize the risk of human error and make data
available in total security and in **real time** to our customers.

#### BVLOS ready

In compliance with the ENAC and the new European regulation we are carrying out the experimentation
to take your operations beyond all limits.

## Manage your data.

#### [VR viewing platform][93]

Our platform allows you to explore open and confined spaces by immersing yourself in the
environment. The customization of the platform, the** GIS integration** and the possibility of
collecting many data allow favor the use of the platform in the** Oil & Gas, Solar, Real Estate,
Heritage** sectors. See an [*example*][94] and [ask us][95] more about this services.

#### [Asset management platform][96]

We have developed together with our partners, leaders in the global drone market, an **asset
management software**. We are able to manage the data collected by drones and other platforms to
identify defects in **bridges**, ***roads*** and ***highways***, ***power lines***, ***photovoltaic
systems*** and ***oil plants***. Our platform, unique in Italy, keeps track of the history of
maintenance interventions and automatically generates reports. 

#### [3D viewing platform][97]

Our way of working is client-center. When we are entrusted with a job, we treat your data
transparently and make it available on our cloud 3d visualization platform. The intermediate
visualization of the deliverables is an integral part of our workflow and makes the customer aware
of our work.

### Help us keep our skies safe by following the drone rules

We are drone enthusiasts who recognize that we need all drone users to fly responsibly. We created
this website to help users understand the drone regulations. We hope it helps you follow the rules
wherever you fly.

“Drone Laws” is a not-for-profit NGO; volunteers manage this website.

Our volunteers regularly check the various websites of drone regulators. They identify if there are
any substantive changes to the drone laws. We will sometimes paraphrase the most important parts of
the laws. Sometimes, we find it better to provide the language directly used by the regulators.

> Drones overall will be more impactful than I think people recognize, in positive ways to help
> society.

> **Bill Gates**

## How To Use

Our database comprises a directory of drone laws by country. We also include some States or
Provinces where applicable. On each page, you will find the latest local and International drone
regulations. We also provide extra resources and links to our sources or regulatory agencies.

We know drone laws change frequently. We suggest you use these pages as a starting point. Then,
visit the source sites for the latest drone regulations and related information.

We encourage you to share your experiences in each jurisdiction. Your insights add to our collective
knowledge of drone rules in that jurisdiction.

GoUAV, suppliers of DJI Enterprise commercial and industrial drones, DJI optical, thermal cameras,
and payloads. We also distribute YellowScan UAV LiDAR systems, Teledyne FLIR Systems sUAS thermal
imaging cameras, MicaSense multispectral sensors (AgEagle), and DJI Terra drone software.

Our range of DJI Enterprise drones includes the [**DJI Mavic 3 Thermal Advanced,** ][54][**Matrice
4E**][55][, **Matrice 4T**][56][, **Matrice 4D**][57]**,**[** Matrice 4TD**][58][**, Matrice

Our professional drone solutions are ideal for aerial applications such as safety and security,
precision agriculture, surveying, mapping, media and thermal inspections.

# GoUAV – Your DJI Enterprise Commercial Drone Distributor Servicing Africa

GoUAV, suppliers of DJI Enterprise commercial and industrial drones, DJI optical, thermal cameras,
and payloads. We also distribute YellowScan UAV LiDAR systems, Teledyne FLIR Systems sUAS thermal
imaging cameras, MicaSense multispectral sensors (AgEagle), and DJI Terra drone software.

Our range of DJI Enterprise drones includes the [**DJI Mavic 3 Thermal Advanced,** ][54][**Matrice
4E**][55][, **Matrice 4T**][56][, **Matrice 4D**][57]**,**[** Matrice 4TD**][58][**, Matrice
400**][59][, **DJI Dock 3 with Matrice 4D**][60]**, **[**DJI Dock 3 with Matrice 4TD**][61]**,**
with the latest payloads like the DJI Zenmuse [**H30**][62], [**H30T**][63], [**L2**][64],
[**L3**][65], [**P1**][66], and application software [**DJI Terra**][67]**, **[**DJI Flighthub
2,**][68]** **and [**DJI Flighthub 2 On-Premises**][69]**. **

Our professional drone solutions are ideal for aerial applications such as safety and security,
precision agriculture, surveying, mapping, media and thermal inspections. 

We compliment our DJI drone products with our professional drone repair services, drone training and
drone camera rental services.

# Your Drone Partner

## Elevating your business together

## Our Mission

### Transforming client potential through cutting-edge drone technology

With 17 years of experience in the drone industry, we've observed an exponential increase in the
availability of diverse hardware and software solutions. Keeping up with this rapid evolution is
increasingly challenging when combined with regulatory compliance. To facilitate your adaptation to
these changes, heliguy™ has established the necessary infrastructure to expedite your adoption.

[About Our Mission][14]

## Consultancy *as standard

### Build your drone programme with heliguy™ by your side

Leverage our two decades of industry expertise to initiate and expand your drone enterprise. Our
committed account managers will collaborate with you to craft the ideal programme, guiding you from
proof of concept and workflow integration to regulatory support and enduring assistance. This is
made possible through a robust and focused infrastructure that encompasses seasoned sales managers,
adept training team members, and specialised technical repairs and servicing divisions.

[Our Consultancy Service][15]

## heliguy™ Drone Training

### 9,000+ candidates trained

Benefit from a progressive training pathway to grow operational capability. Provision includes
CAA-approved courses, industry-specific training, CPD, and Ofqual-regulated learning for career
development. Online courses and instructor-led training available. Learn from a team that has taught
Network Rail, National Grid, Balfour Beatty VINCI, and London Fire Brigade.

### UK SORA & BVLOS operations

Master complex operations to scale your drone programme. Our regulatory specialists help you prepare
UK SORA applications to expand your operational envelope and develop BVLOS pathways. Unleash the
full potential of automated drone missions.

[In-house Consultancy][17]

# Optimizing Crop Treatment

# CONTROL YOUR DATA

All flight and application data is stored on your AgroSol account. You can access digital as-applied
maps directly through our interface. You can export this data in a variety of formats to streamline
billing and regulatory compliance.

# STREAMLINED WORK FLOW

You can go from mapping to spraying in a matter of minutes. You can command up to three AgDrones per
ground station.

# SPOT OR BROADCAST TREATMENTS

Deploy fleets of autonomous AgDrones to tackle high-acreage, broadcast treatments. Maximize your
cost savings by treating only the areas that need attention.

[Agrosol Logo]

AgroSol is Hylio’s flagship ground control software. AgroSol is easy to pick up and optimized for
agricultural work flow. You don’t have to be an expert pilot or engineer; anyone can easily map,
plan, and execute crop treatments using AgroSol.

You can assign treatment missions to your AgDrones, click “Take off”, and then watch the drones do
the rest. Once they have finished their job, or have run out of payload, they will automatically
return home for their next task.

[Learn More][99]

# PRECISION CROP CARE

AT YOUR FINGERTIPS - AVAILABLE TODAY!

Crop spraying drones are no longer just a fun concept; our technology has been boosting yields and
cutting costs for years.

Our technology is accessible and affordable. Reach out to us today to speak with one of our
technical experts to learn how AgDrones can optimize your crop production.

You can email us at contact@hyl.io, call us at 1-832-219-6778, or chat with us instantly on our
website chat tool.

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

# The Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Bible

This project works from the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church’s canonical tradition, preserved
through the ancient Geʽez manuscript lineage and transmitted to the Church through centuries of
faithful use.

When compared alongside the King James Bible, differences in wording, cadence, and structure reveal
how translation traditions can shape the way God’s character is heard—sometimes emphasizing
immediacy, severity, or judgment in English where older Semitic traditions preserve sequence,
restraint, and relational continuity.

The Ethiopian canon represents the oldest continuously used biblical tradition in the world, with
manuscripts dating to the 5th–6th century AD. Its textual witness does not change events or
doctrine, but often preserves tone and narrative flow in ways that allow readers to perceive
continuity between the God of the Old Testament and the Christ revealed in Jesus.

This study does not seek to replace Scripture, but to listen more carefully to it—by placing the
King James Bible and the Ethiopian Orthodox canon side by side and allowing the language itself to
speak.

# The Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Bible

This project works from the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church’s canonical tradition, preserved
through the ancient Geʽez manuscript lineage and transmitted to the Church through centuries of
faithful use.

When compared alongside the King James Bible, differences in wording, cadence, and structure reveal
how translation traditions can shape the way God’s character is heard—sometimes emphasizing
immediacy, severity, or judgment in English where older Semitic traditions preserve sequence,
restraint, and relational continuity.

The Ethiopian canon represents the oldest continuously used biblical tradition in the world, with
manuscripts dating to the 5th–6th century AD. Its textual witness does not change events or
doctrine, but often preserves tone and narrative flow in ways that allow readers to perceive
continuity between the God of the Old Testament and the Christ revealed in Jesus.

This study does not seek to replace Scripture, but to listen more carefully to it—by placing the
King James Bible and the Ethiopian Orthodox canon side by side and allowing the language itself to
speak.

#### Rotary-wing UAV

**Premium carbon-fiber rotary drones for industrial and commercial surveillance.**

GO
[ ][184]

### [15KG Spring Knife][185]

The "Spring Knife" incorporates a foldable wing mechanism: while stowed inside the launch tube, its
wings stay folded to conserve space. As soon as it exits the tube, the wings snap open rapidly,
furnishing the cruise missile with essential lift and flight stability. This design confers greater
convenience and flexibility upon the "Spring Knife" in terms of both transport and deployment.
[ ][186]

### [6KG Spring Knife][187]

The "Spring Knife" cruise missile features a foldable wing design: when housed within its launch
tube, the wings remain folded to minimize space occupation. Upon exiting the launch tube, the wings
rapidly deploy, generating the necessary lift and ensuring stability during cruise flight. This
innovative design significantly enhances the "Spring Knife"'s portability and launch flexibility.
[ ][188]

### [China Moneypro 10][189]

The China Moneypro 10 is a heavy-lift industrial hexacopter with 70kg payload, 60min flight time,
and 30km transmission. IP54-rated, GNSS-compatible, and designed for energy, agriculture, and search
& rescue missions in extreme environments.
[ ][190]

### [China Moneypro 12][191]

The China Moneypro 12 is a powerhouse heavy-lift drone with 100kg payload, 4000mm wheelbase, and
30km transmission. Built for industrial missions in extreme weather (IP44, -20~60°C), it delivers
precision with multi-GNSS navigation.
[ ][192]

### [China Moneypro 2C][193]

The China Moneypro 2C is optimized for efficiency and adaptability, featuring
GPS+GLONASS+BeiDou+Galileo navigation, AES256 encryption, and IP54-rated protection. Whether used
for security, surveying, or delivery, this drone provides high endurance (up to 60 mins), long-range
control (20 km), and multi-environment adaptability (-20°C to 60°C).
[ ][194]

### [China Moneypro 2M][195]

The China Moneypro 2M is a lightweight (1.46 kg) yet powerful RTK drone designed for mapping,
inspection, and surveying. With RTK/PPK precision (10 mm horizontal, 20 mm vertical), 7 km control
range, and 50-minute flight time, it’s ideal for professionals in construction, agriculture, and
energy sectors. Equipped with a high-res visible camera (8MP) & thermal imaging (640×512), this UAV
ensures detailed data capture in all conditions.
[ ][196]

### [China Moneypro 2P][197]

The China Moneypro 2P is a heavy-duty industrial drone built for long-range, high-payload missions.
With an impressive 2.5 kg payload capacity, 55-minute flight time, and extended 30 km transmission
range, this 970mm wheelbase hexacopter excels in power line inspections, emergency response, and
large-area mapping. Its IP54-rated rugged design operates in -20°C to 60°C, making it ideal for
harsh environments and complex industrial applications.
[ ][198]

### [China Moneypro 2S][199]

The China Moneypro 2S is a high-performance, lightweight industrial drone with 1 kg payload
capacity, 50-minute flight time, and 20 km transmission range. Built with a 650mm wheelbase &
IP54-rated rugged design, it supports RTK/PPK positioning (GPS+GLONASS+BeiDou+Galileo) and operates
in -20°C to 60°C, making it ideal for mapping, inspections, and surveillance. Its compact, foldable
(510×510×400 mm) design ensures easy transport without sacrificing power.

#### Airplane & VTOL

**Long-endurance fixed-wing drones for mapping, surveillance, and logistics.**

Go

### [China Moneypro M320 4hrs Long Endurance Electric VTOL Tail-push Airplane][202]

Engineered for maximum efficiency, the China Moneypro M320 Electric VTOL UAV combines a 4-hour
flight time, 6kg payload capacity, and cutting-edge aerodynamics, delivering unmatched productivity
for long-range surveillance, mapping, and emergency response.
[ ][203]

### [M-40 Vertical Takeoff And Landing Composite Wing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle][204]

The M-40 is a high-performance VTOL UAV that combines the operational flexibility of vertical
takeoffs and landings with the efficiency of a composite-wing fixed-wing aircraft. Its advanced
materials and aerodynamic design deliver exceptional endurance, speed, and payload capacity while
minimizing its radar signature.
This versatile platform seamlessly transitions between hover and forward flight, enabling operations
from confined spaces without requiring runways. Equipped with a sophisticated avionics suite and
autonomous flight systems, the M-40 excels in intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, and
logistics missions across diverse and challenging environments.
[ ][205]

### [Drone Platform Moneypro 250][206]

The Moneypro 250 is a high-performance fixed-wing drone designed for long-endurance missions (up to
30 hours) with a 280 kg max payload capacity, ideal for surveillance, mapping, and logistics.
[ ][207]

### [China Moneypro M210 Long Endurance Portable eVTOL Drone for Mapping and Surveillance][208]

21m/s aerial surveying platform with 180×150×110mm payload bay – switch between 4+1/4+2 propulsion
modes for custom mission profiles.
[ ][209]

### [China Moneypro M230 2.5hrs Long-endurance with 1kg Payload Compact VTOL Mapping UAV][210]

90km/h survey UAV with 100km operational radius – deployable in <1 minute via tool-free assembly for
rapid-response missions.
[ ][211]

### [China Moneypro M240 Bionic VTOL Drone Smooth Flight UAV max 1.6kg Payload 3.5hrs
### Endurance][212]

3.85kg carbon-core airframe with all-moving stabilizer achieves 210-minute survey missions 4,500m
high – triple the endurance of industrial competitors.
[ ][213]

### [15KG Spring Knife][185]

The "Spring Knife" incorporates a foldable wing mechanism: while stowed inside the launch tube, its
wings stay folded to conserve space. As soon as it exits the tube, the wings snap open rapidly,
furnishing the cruise missile with essential lift and flight stability. This design confers greater
convenience and flexibility upon the "Spring Knife" in terms of both transport and deployment.
[ ][186]

### [6KG Spring Knife][187]

The "Spring Knife" cruise missile features a foldable wing design: when housed within its launch
tube, the wings remain folded to minimize space occupation. Upon exiting the launch tube, the wings
rapidly deploy, generating the necessary lift and ensuring stability during cruise flight. This
innovative design significantly enhances the "Spring Knife"'s portability and launch flexibility.
[ ][188]

### [China Moneypro 10][189]

The China Moneypro 10 is a heavy-lift industrial hexacopter with 70kg payload, 60min flight time,
and 30km transmission. IP54-rated, GNSS-compatible, and designed for energy, agriculture, and search
& rescue missions in extreme environments.
[ ][190]

### [China Moneypro 12][191]

The China Moneypro 12 is a powerhouse heavy-lift drone with 100kg payload, 4000mm wheelbase, and
30km transmission. Built for industrial missions in extreme weather (IP44, -20~60°C), it delivers
precision with multi-GNSS navigation.
[ ][192]

### [China Moneypro 2C][193]

The China Moneypro 2C is optimized for efficiency and adaptability, featuring
GPS+GLONASS+BeiDou+Galileo navigation, AES256 encryption, and IP54-rated protection. Whether used
for security, surveying, or delivery, this drone provides high endurance (up to 60 mins), long-range
control (20 km), and multi-environment adaptability (-20°C to 60°C).
[ ][194]

### [China Moneypro 2M][195]

The China Moneypro 2M is a lightweight (1.46 kg) yet powerful RTK drone designed for mapping,
inspection, and surveying. With RTK/PPK precision (10 mm horizontal, 20 mm vertical), 7 km control
range, and 50-minute flight time, it’s ideal for professionals in construction, agriculture, and
energy sectors. Equipped with a high-res visible camera (8MP) & thermal imaging (640×512), this UAV
ensures detailed data capture in all conditions.
[ ][196]

### [China Moneypro 2P][197]

The China Moneypro 2P is a heavy-duty industrial drone built for long-range, high-payload missions.
With an impressive 2.5 kg payload capacity, 55-minute flight time, and extended 30 km transmission
range, this 970mm wheelbase hexacopter excels in power line inspections, emergency response, and
large-area mapping. Its IP54-rated rugged design operates in -20°C to 60°C, making it ideal for
harsh environments and complex industrial applications.
[ ][198]

### [China Moneypro 2S][199]

The China Moneypro 2S is a high-performance, lightweight industrial drone with 1 kg payload
capacity, 50-minute flight time, and 20 km transmission range. Built with a 650mm wheelbase &
IP54-rated rugged design, it supports RTK/PPK positioning (GPS+GLONASS+BeiDou+Galileo) and operates
in -20°C to 60°C, making it ideal for mapping, inspections, and surveillance. Its compact, foldable
(510×510×400 mm) design ensures easy transport without sacrificing power.

flight time, 6kg payload capacity, and cutting-edge aerodynamics, delivering unmatched productivity
for long-range surveillance, mapping, and emergency response.
[ ][203]

### [M-40 Vertical Takeoff And Landing Composite Wing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle][204]

The M-40 is a high-performance VTOL UAV that combines the operational flexibility of vertical
takeoffs and landings with the efficiency of a composite-wing fixed-wing aircraft. Its advanced
materials and aerodynamic design deliver exceptional endurance, speed, and payload capacity while
minimizing its radar signature.
This versatile platform seamlessly transitions between hover and forward flight, enabling operations
from confined spaces without requiring runways. Equipped with a sophisticated avionics suite and
autonomous flight systems, the M-40 excels in intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, and
logistics missions across diverse and challenging environments.
[ ][205]

The Moneypro 250 is a high-performance fixed-wing drone designed for long-endurance missions (up to
30 hours) with a 280 kg max payload capacity, ideal for surveillance, mapping, and logistics.

# The open standards for drone hardware

Pixhawk open standards provides readily available hardware specifications and guidelines for drone
systems development

[Download the Standards][7][Participate][8]

##  The reference standards

All aspects of mechanical and electrical specifications for creating interoperable drone system
components

## Autopilot

Flight management unit 

[ Learn more][9]

## Payload

Cameras, gimbals, actuators

[ Learn more][10]

## Smart Battery

Battery management unit

[Learn more][11]

## Benefits for adopters



### Accelerate time to market with reference designs



### Reduce R&D overheads with jointly engineered solutions



### Scale product interoperability with the ecosystem

###### THE ORIGIN

## A decade of rich history and
## a fast growing community

A decade ago, “Pixhawk” was a student project at ETH Zurich. Little did the team know that it would
end up having such a large influence on the drone industry. During this time, the team created
MAVLink, Pixhawk, PX4, and QGroundcontrol — which are today’s most used standards for flight control
hardware and autopilot software in the drone industry. This was the beginning of a story of a very
successful open source project outperforming individual corporate development.

[Read the story from Lorenz Meier, the founder of Pixhawk and PX4][12]


## Created by industry leaders 

Pixhawk is the defacto standard for those who build the ubiquitous autonomous systems that will
support a better world for humanity.

Arnaud Thiercelin

Head of Enterprise Product, Auterion

NXP is pleased to participate in the development of an open standard by working with the community.
Together, we ensure quality, safety, and efficiency of modern autonomous systems products.

Iain Galloway

Drone Program Lead, NXP

At Freefly we greatly value simple and effective open standards and protocols, and we are excited to
help create these for the industry!

Cory Schwarzmiller

Senior Embedded Systems Engineer, Freefly

The Pixhawk Smart Battery Standard will increase the safety, interoperability, and professionalism
of the open source UAV ecosystem.

Alex Klimaj

Founder, ARK Electronics

## Supported by a global end-user and developer community

Connect with other drone developers, robotics experts from around the world

[Discord][13]
[Forum][14]

## Join the community mailing list 

[Sign up now][15]

##  Sponsored by Dronecode Foundation members 

Learn [how to become][16] a member to support the standardization efforts and be part of the
evolving ecosystem. 

[See Full Member List][17]

# The open standards for drone hardware

Pixhawk open standards provides readily available hardware specifications and guidelines for drone
systems development

[Download the Standards][7][Participate][8]

##  The reference standards

All aspects of mechanical and electrical specifications for creating interoperable drone system
components

## Autopilot

Flight management unit 

[ Learn more][9]

## Payload

Cameras, gimbals, actuators

[ Learn more][10]

## Smart Battery

Battery management unit

[Learn more][11]

## Benefits for adopters



### Accelerate time to market with reference designs



### Reduce R&D overheads with jointly engineered solutions



### Scale product interoperability with the ecosystem

###### THE ORIGIN

## A decade of rich history and
## a fast growing community

A decade ago, “Pixhawk” was a student project at ETH Zurich. Little did the team know that it would
end up having such a large influence on the drone industry. During this time, the team created
MAVLink, Pixhawk, PX4, and QGroundcontrol — which are today’s most used standards for flight control
hardware and autopilot software in the drone industry. This was the beginning of a story of a very
successful open source project outperforming individual corporate development.

[Read the story from Lorenz Meier, the founder of Pixhawk and PX4][12]


## Created by industry leaders 

Pixhawk is the defacto standard for those who build the ubiquitous autonomous systems that will
support a better world for humanity.

Arnaud Thiercelin

Head of Enterprise Product, Auterion

NXP is pleased to participate in the development of an open standard by working with the community.
Together, we ensure quality, safety, and efficiency of modern autonomous systems products.

Iain Galloway

Drone Program Lead, NXP

At Freefly we greatly value simple and effective open standards and protocols, and we are excited to
help create these for the industry!

Cory Schwarzmiller

Senior Embedded Systems Engineer, Freefly

The Pixhawk Smart Battery Standard will increase the safety, interoperability, and professionalism
of the open source UAV ecosystem.

Alex Klimaj

Founder, ARK Electronics

## Supported by a global end-user and developer community

Connect with other drone developers, robotics experts from around the world

[Discord][13]
[Forum][14]

## Join the community mailing list 

[Sign up now][15]

##  Sponsored by Dronecode Foundation members 

Learn [how to become][16] a member to support the standardization efforts and be part of the
evolving ecosystem. 

[See Full Member List][17]

## F.A.Q.

##### Here Are Some Common Questions Customers Ask About SRIZFLY Drone Simulator

How to download and activate the SRIZFLY software?
:To download and activate our software, here’s what you need to know:
For the Free Trial Version
Simply fill out the Download form when you click download or free trial use.
Once downloaded, you can install and use the trial version directly – no activation is required.
 
For the Full Version
Purchase the full-featured version plan on our website. After completing your order, the download
link will be displayed on your order page and your email notification.

You will also receive an email with the activation code for your software.

Enter the activation code after installation to unlock the full version and use it for the
corresponding duration.

Which remote controllers are compatible with the simulator? Are specific cables or adapters
required?
SRIZFLY is compatible with a wide range of remote controllers, including (but not limited to):
* DJI: RC-N1, RC-N2, RC-N3, RC-Plus
* FUTABA: T6K V3S, T10J, T14SG
* Flysky: FS-I6S, FS-ST8
* TARANIS: X9D Plus, SM001
* Spektrum: Interlink DX
* Gaming Controllers: XBOX Series X, and more

You want to move faster, do more, and cut costs.

At Target Arm, we understand how frustrating it is to adopt tech that ends up slowing you down

## What to Expect

Join us for a needs and integration assessment.

Host a pilot project for testing solutions on a small scale. 

Place an enterprise order for full-scale integration.

## Why Work With Us?

###### Hands-Free Drone Autonomy
* Fully automated launch and recovery with one button.
* AI-enhanced decision-making and machine learning makes continuous improvements. 
* Fixed-wing or rotary-wing drone compatible. 
* Drone automatic recall at low battery

###### Flexible Deployment, Any Platform
* Mounts to any land, sea, air, or space platform.
* Functions on any vehicle, at all speeds.
* Reliable across varied terrain and windy conditions.
* Accuracy within less than 1 millimeter

###### Easy Setup, Minimal Training
* Simple system interface.
* Custom Installation or integration available.
* Scalable designs to match your needs

###### Support That Stays With You
* Dedicated onboarding and after-delivery support
* Continuous updates based on your feedback
* Built to meet the needs for package delivery, defense, first responders, and you

[Target Arm live testing]

## Push a Button, Change Everything.

You want to move faster, do more, and cut costs.

Drones can help—but using them from moving vehicles is tough. It’s complex, slow, and often forces
you to stop.

That’s a problem we solve.


At Target Arm, we understand how frustrating it is to adopt tech that ends up slowing you down
instead of speeding you up.

That’s why we are experts in launching and recovering drones from moving vehicles.


Here’s how it works:

1. You stay focused on your objective—whether it's delivering a package or responding to an
   emergency.
2. You hit one button to launch a drone—no pilot, no steering, no stopping.
3. When your drone’s mission is complete, you hit one button to recover it—all while still on the
   move.

[Buy Today ][30]

Stop feeling powerless, slowed down, or left behind and start leading your industry.
Integrate drones on-the-move and finally see the results you know you're capable of.

## Over 20 years of experience.

## About UAV Navigation-Grupo Oesía

UAV Navigation is a 100% Spanish capital, private and independent specialized in the design of
**guidance, navigation and control solutions (GNC)** for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) since 2004.

UAV Navigation's flight control solutions are **used by a variety of Tier 1 aerospace
manufacturers** in a wide range of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) - also known as Remotely Piloted
Aircraft Systems (RPAS) or 'drones'.

[Read more][113]

## About Grupo Oesía

UAV Navigation is part of Oesia Group, a Spanish group of multinational companies with more than 50
years of experience designing, developing and maintaining cutting-edge technology for the Security,
Defense and Aerospace sectors with a long history of work in avionics for important projects.

# The #1 Profit Checker App
# For Resellers & Flippers

Flip Smarter. Skip Faster.

Stop wasting hours researching deals. Scan any item to see instant profits, fees, and red flags in
30 seconds. Track your entire inventory from sourcing to sale. The complete reselling app for thrift
stores, garage sales & Facebook Marketplace.

[Find Your First Deal Free][8]
✓ 5 free analyses ✓ Secure & Private ✓ AI-Powered ✓ Results in Seconds

## Three Steps to Smarter Sourcing

Flip Smarter. Skip Faster.

### Snap Any Item

Photo a thrift store find, screenshot a Facebook Marketplace listing, or snap garage sale items.

### See Instant Profit

Get real-time eBay sold comps, profit margins, and fee breakdowns with AI in seconds.

### Buy or Skip with Confidence

Make data-driven decisions. Save winners to your Flip Tracker. Skip the losers.

## What Underpriced Actually Helps You Decide

Underpriced is designed for the real decisions that determine whether a flip is worth your time:
what an item actually sells for, what fees and shipping do to your margin, how quickly it is likely
to move, and whether the risk profile is acceptable for your bankroll.

### Comp Research

Check recent sold data instead of relying on wishful active listings. That helps you spot false
optimism before you buy and keeps your pricing anchored to what buyers actually paid.

### Margin Protection

Account for platform fees, shipping drag, and item-specific costs before you commit. Small math
errors repeated across dozens of flips quietly erase good sourcing work.

### Faster Skip Decisions

Not every item deserves a deep dive. Underpriced helps you identify passes faster so your time and
capital stay available for inventory with stronger demand and cleaner upside.

For newer resellers, that means fewer beginner mistakes like buying into bad comps, underestimating
shipping, or confusing gross sale price with actual profit. For experienced sellers, it means
compressing research time and standardizing decisions across higher listing volume.

The public site, free tools, and blog exist to make those decisions clearer before you ever open the
paid experience. The app simply takes the same logic deeper with live analysis, saved history, and
workflow shortcuts built for people actively sourcing and listing inventory every week.

## Questions from Flippers

Why should I pay when eBay sold is free?

Time is money. Checking eBay sold takes 2-3 minutes per item: searching, scrolling through results,
mentally calculating fees and shipping. At a garage sale with 50 potential items, that's 2+ hours of
standing around researching. We do it in 30 seconds with instant profit calculations, platform fee
breakdowns, and red flags. Same 50 items? 25 minutes total. Plus everything is saved, tracked, and
organized. The paid tiers cost less than one decent flip - and you'll find that flip faster.

How is this different from checking eBay sold or asking AI myself?

Three things: speed, accuracy, and tracking. Asking ChatGPT or similar gives you generic guesses
without real market data. We combine instant AI identification with actual sales data, then
automatically calculate platform fees, shipping estimates, and net ROI. Plus, every analysis is
saved to your account so you can track what you've researched, compare items over time, and move
items directly to your Flip Tracker.

Where does the price data come from?

We aggregate pricing data from multiple sources including completed sales, active listings, and
historical market trends. The AI identifies your item from the photo, cross-references comparable
items across platforms, and synthesizes this data to provide accurate market values with confidence
levels based on how many data points we found.

What can I analyze? Does it work on any item?

Anything you can photograph. Electronics, clothing, collectibles, toys, tools, furniture: if people
buy it on eBay, we can analyze it. Works with photos you take, screenshots from FB Marketplace,
OfferUp, Craigslist, or any other source. The AI is trained on millions of product images.

How accurate is the net profit calculation?

We use current platform fee rates (eBay 13.25%, Mercari 10%, Poshmark 20%, FB Marketplace 0%).
Shipping estimates are based on typical costs for the item category and size. Your actual results
may vary slightly based on your negotiated shipping rates or promotional fee discounts, but you'll
be within a few dollars.

What's the Flip Tracker?

Built-in inventory management. When you decide to BUY an item, add it to your tracker in one click.
Track what you paid, where you're listing it, and record the sale when it sells. Get real P&L
numbers, ROI by category, average days to sell, and exportable reports for taxes.

The weekly Ad, also called circular ads, is an influential marketing tool retailers use to advertise
their goods and services. They are generally published in print or on the Internet and offer
discounts on various products.

Retailers utilize weekly advertisements to draw new customers, promote returning business, and
reduce stock. Weekly ads are an excellent method for saving money shopping. Through browsing weekly
ads of your preferred merchants, you can get discounts on everything from groceries and clothing to
electronic gadgets.

You can also utilize the weekly advertisements for planning your shopping trip so that you know what
you need to purchase and where to buy it.

There are several methods to locate weekly ads. They are usually found in the local paper or look
them up online. There are also a lot of websites that combine weekly ads from various retail
outlets.

After you’ve found the weekly advertisements you’re interested in, you can begin planning your
shopping trip. Compare prices across different stores and look for promo codes and coupons that
could save you more money.

The weekly Ad, also called circular ads, is an influential marketing tool retailers use to advertise
their goods and services. They are generally published in print or on the Internet and offer
discounts on various products.

Retailers utilize weekly advertisements to draw new customers, promote returning business, and
reduce stock. Weekly ads are an excellent method for saving money shopping. Through browsing weekly
ads of your preferred merchants, you can get discounts on everything from groceries and clothing to
electronic gadgets.

You can also utilize the weekly advertisements for planning your shopping trip so that you know what
you need to purchase and where to buy it.

There are several methods to locate weekly ads. They are usually found in the local paper or look
them up online. There are also a lot of websites that combine weekly ads from various retail
outlets.

After you’ve found the weekly advertisements you’re interested in, you can begin planning your
shopping trip. Compare prices across different stores and look for promo codes and coupons that
could save you more money.

## Payloads that *redraw the map.*

From power-line inspection at 300 m to disaster response over flooded terrain — enterprise drones do
the work humans shouldn’t. Watch the DJI Matrice 400 RTK run a real mission. 6 kg payload, 59-minute
endurance, LiDAR + thermal + zoom.

Matrice 400 RTK Autel EVO Max 4T Flyability Elios 3 Real deployments
[Explore drones →][108]
WATCH IT WALK · HUMANOIDS

## The general-purpose worker, *on two legs.*

Bipedal robots aren’t science fiction anymore. The Unitree G1 — 1.3 m tall, 47 degrees of freedom,
developer-ready — walks, dances, and manipulates the world around it. Watch what a humanoid platform
looks like when it’s built for industry, research, and everything in between.

Unitree H1 Unitree H2 Unitree G1 Industry + research
[Explore humanoids →][109]
SEE IT RUN · ROBOT DOGS

## Four legs, *all terrain.*

Stairs, mud, gravel, snow — the Unitree Go2 handles what wheels can’t. 4D LiDAR, AI side-follow, 5
m/s sprint. Security patrols, industrial inspection, research labs and film sets are already using
them. Watch it move.

Unitree Go2 Unitree B2 Alpha Robotics Security + inspection
[Explore robot dogs →][110]

at 60 fps, 166° FOV, AI vision lock and 6-thruster omnidirectional movement — down to 100 m. No
divers required. See what your eyes have been missing.

## Payloads that *redraw the map.*

From power-line inspection at 300 m to disaster response over flooded terrain — enterprise drones do
the work humans shouldn’t. Watch the DJI Matrice 400 RTK run a real mission. 6 kg payload, 59-minute
endurance, LiDAR + thermal + zoom.

Matrice 400 RTK Autel EVO Max 4T Flyability Elios 3 Real deployments
[Explore drones →][108]
WATCH IT WALK · HUMANOIDS

## The general-purpose worker, *on two legs.*

Bipedal robots aren’t science fiction anymore. The Unitree G1 — 1.3 m tall, 47 degrees of freedom,
developer-ready — walks, dances, and manipulates the world around it. Watch what a humanoid platform
looks like when it’s built for industry, research, and everything in between.

Unitree H1 Unitree H2 Unitree G1 Industry + research
[Explore humanoids →][109]
SEE IT RUN · ROBOT DOGS

## Four legs, *all terrain.*

Stairs, mud, gravel, snow — the Unitree Go2 handles what wheels can’t. 4D LiDAR, AI side-follow, 5
m/s sprint. Security patrols, industrial inspection, research labs and film sets are already using
them. Watch it move.

Unitree Go2 Unitree B2 Alpha Robotics Security + inspection
[Explore robot dogs →][110]
DIVE IN · UNDERWATER ROVS

## The depths, *in 4K.*

Hull inspection, dam surveys, offshore rigs, marine research. The QYSEA FIFISH V-EVO delivers 4K UHD
at 60 fps, 166° FOV, AI vision lock and 6-thruster omnidirectional movement — down to 100 m. No
divers required. See what your eyes have been missing.
